subject: fixing a 12-item flat navigation
ruling: DEC-01 wins as the constraint: the bar is five to seven destinations before MPA-01's ordering applies. MPA-01's original remedy assumed a 12-item bar, which is the situation DEC-01 removes.

subject: the Cmd/Ctrl+K search shortcut
ruling: HMM-01's never-hijack check wins over its own Cmd/Ctrl+K example: a browser command cannot be reliably taken by the page, so the remedy uses /, which the page receives before the browser's quick-find default.
